analysis: The causal-prefix trial completed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.4263, versus 0.4713 for the prior sampler and the reported SASRec reference of 0.505. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.450, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.485, Electronics 0.350, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.420. Against the supplied category references, Movies_and_TV declined from 0.505, while Electronics rose slightly from 0.345. This result does not support the prefix-only sampler under the unchanged training configuration. Shorter prefixes reduce available context and change the supervision distribution; these are plausible explanations, not established causes. The run consumed 125.39 allocated GPU-seconds. No test results were available.
code_summary: Retained the per-category AttentiveSimilarity model: separate 96-dimensional context and target embeddings, item biases, 32-dimensional candidate-conditioned attention, bounded exponential attention weights, square-root normalization, and 0.1 context dropout. Changed training examples to sample a target after the first interaction and use only its preceding prefix, retaining repeated target items in that prefix. Preserved history truncation/subsampling, 15% context dropout, right-aligned padding, 16 negatives excluded against the complete training history, cross-entropy, embedding regularization, AdamW, early stopping, and the 200-epoch environment default. Added deterministic sampler checks that restore NumPy RNG state. All four dataset routes, trial-local checkpoints, and the predictor writer/inference behavior remained unchanged.
